name: FoodBoxBooker
author: themetechmount

sections.description:
FoodboxBooker is an intuitive WordPress plugin designed specifically for food delivery businesses, tiffin services, and meal subscription providers. 🍱🥢 With this plugin, you can easily showcase your menus, manage customer orders, and streamline the food or tiffin ordering process. 🛍️🍛

🔗 Useful Links

FoodboxBooker Demos

Main Features of FoodboxBooker

  • 🍱 Stunning Menu Display: Showcase your delicious offerings with customizable menu layouts. Add mouthwatering photos, detailed descriptions, and pricing to capture customers’ attention.
  • ⚡ Quick Online Ordering: A user-friendly system for placing tiffin orders with just a few clicks, ensuring a hassle-free experience for your customers.
  • 📆 Subscription-Based Services: Manage weekly or monthly meal plans effortlessly, allowing customers to enjoy regular tiffin deliveries without repeated orders.
  • 💳 Easy Online Payment: Simplify the checkout process with built-in support for popular payment gateways, ensuring fast and secure transactions every time.
  • 🎨 Flexible Customization Options: Personalize your menus with colors, fonts, and layouts that match your brand’s unique identity and charm.
  • 🌍 Multi-Language Support: Reach a global audience by offering your services in multiple languages, making your business more inclusive and accessible.
sections.installation:
How to install the FoodBoxBooker Plugin

Please follow the steps for installation:

VIA WordPress

  1. After your download log into your WordPress admin interface
  2. After login click on Plugins from the left-hand menu
  3. Click on Add new
  4. Click on Upload
  5. Browse to the directory you downloaded the plugin to and click Install Now
  6. After WordPress has finished unpacking the file click on Activate Plugin
  7. After the plugin has been activated you will notice a new menu item on the left-hand navigation labeled FoodBoxBooker
  8. Done. Start exploring the world’s best WordPress foodboxbooking plugin!
sections.faq:
How easy is it to set up?

It is ridiculously easy to set up the FoodBoxBooker plugin.

How to uninstall the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete the plugin.

Which page builders are supported?

FoodBoxBooker has dedicated blocks for following Page Builders
1) Classic Editor of WordPress
2) Gutenberg page builder of WordPress
3) Elementor Website Builder
4) WPBakery Page Builder

Do I need to have coding skills to use FoodBoxBooker Plugin?

There is no need to learn any coding skills for operating FoodBoxBooker Plugin

How can I contact FoodBoxBooker Booking support ?

Visit our official support site at support forum. Our team will be happy to answer any of your questions!
